goal: Complete J-Quants Production Feature Materialization with Production explicitly meaning the live Supabase-backed read model and current Research Workspace v2, not local Parquet or SQLite stores. Create a Supabase migration and bounded production materialization path for a dedicated ex-post research outcomes table (for example jq_research_security_outcomes) keyed by security/date, populated from existing jq_market_price_daily data with 1/5/20/60 trading-day forward returns and benchmark-relative excess returns. Keep these outcomes structurally separate from PIT/current features, use adjusted prices and deterministic session alignment, preserve nulls when future sessions are unavailable, and use no new external provider calls for outcome calculation. The production backfill/refresh must be idempotent, incremental, resumable, indexed, provenance-aware, and safe for roughly the existing full-market price history. Do not use engine/features/store.py, local Parquet datasets, or local SQLite tables as the final production destination. Prefer existing Supabase migrations, RPC/SQL, Edge Functions, and current cloud-sync patterns after inspecting the repository. Connect the already-implemented shareholder-benefit and total-yield logic into the live Supabase jq_market_yield publication/backfill path. Populate investable capital, annual benefit value, benefit yield and total yield only when reliable source evidence exists; preserve unknown states and provenance. If current production benefit source coverage is insufficient, implement the correct production contract/path and report the coverage gap rather than fabricating values or adding broad scraping. Expose the production results through the current Workspace v2/API paths such as engine/workspace/*_v2.py, engine/workspace/metric_catalog_v2.py and apps/api/research_v2.py when those are the active surfaces; do not rely only on legacy/local APIs. Add tests and audits for null coverage, staleness, benchmark alignment, idempotent backfill, and PIT/look-ahead leakage. Preserve EDINET/J-Quants quota limits, request reserves, fail-closed behavior, atomic publication, and CI. Do not add unrelated data categories or unbounded per-security fetching. Success means the live Supabase design and code path can actually materialize/backfill/refresh ex-post outcomes and supported total-yield fields, and current Workspace v2 can safely consume them for testing whether historical signals were followed by future excess returns.
